title: An endomorphism of a finite module is killed by a monic polynomial
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $M$ a finite (finitely generated) $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and $\varphi:M\to M$ an $R$-linear endomorphism. Then there is a monic polynomial $P=T^d+a_{d-1}T^{d-1}+\cdots+a_0\in R[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] ($d\ge0$, $a_i\in R$) such that $P(\varphi)=\varphi^d+a_{d-1}\varphi^{d-1}+\cdots+a_1\varphi+a_0\,\mathrm{id}_M=0$ as an endomorphism of $M$.
